title: 星期天去商场
topicEn: Going to the mall on Sunday

explanations.1: It tells when the story happens, a specific day.
explanations.2: It specifies the time of day.
explanations.3: It refers to the group including the speaker.
explanations.6: It means home, the place they started from.
explanations.7: It means inside, from inside home.
explanations.8: It is the destination, the mall.
explanations.9: It indicates existence of many people.
explanations.10: It refers to the people in the mall.
explanations.11: It indicates the front side of the store.
explanations.12: It tells what kind of store they went to.
explanations.13: It means store, a place to buy things.
explanations.14: It refers to the person being asked.
explanations.15: It is a question word asking for a specific item.
explanations.16: It is a measure word for clothes.
explanations.17: It describes the color of the clothes.
explanations.18: It expresses the friend's feeling towards the clothes.
explanations.20: It negates the action of buying.

translation: On Sunday morning, we went together from home to the mall. There were many people in the mall. We went to a clothing store in front. I asked my friend which piece of clothing she wanted to buy, and she said she wanted to buy a red one. There were many beautiful clothes there, and my friend liked a red one. But it was too expensive; she would not buy it. Later, we went to a milk tea shop. I bought a cup of milk tea, and my friend drank a cup of coffee. We were talking inside. Later, we also went to the supermarket. I bought two apples and a piece of bread, and my friend bought a cup of water. We all happily went home.
